guide.timeoutTitle: The device took too long to respond
guide.timeoutStep1: Try again — it usually works the second time.
guide.timeoutStep2: If you are indoors, move near a window or turn on WiFi.
guide.timeoutNote: If you are in a hurry, pick a neighbourhood from the list — it works just as well.
guide.pcTitle: Location is turned off on the computer
guide.pcStep3: Turn them on, and tick the browser you are using.
guide.pcStep4: Come back here and press “Near me” again.
guide.pcNote: It is a computer setting, not a site setting — that is why no prompt appears.
guide.deviceTitle: The device could not find where you are
guide.deviceStep1: Check that location (GPS) is turned on on the device.
guide.deviceStep2: Try again in a moment or near a window.
guide.iosTitle: The iPhone is not sharing the location
guide.iosStep1: Settings → Privacy & Security → Location Services → on.
guide.iosStep2: In the same list find Safari → “While Using the App”.
guide.iosStep4: Come back here, refresh the page and press “Near me” again.
guide.noReask: The browser does not ask again on its own once you have said “no”.
guide.androidTitle: The phone is not sharing the location
guide.androidStep1: Tap the padlock next to the address, at the top of the page.
guide.chromeTitle: Chrome is not sharing the location
guide.chromeStep1: Click the icon left of the address (padlock or sliders).
guide.chromeStep3: Refresh the page and press “Near me” again.
guide.safariTitle: Safari is not sharing the location
guide.safariStep3: If it does not appear, also check: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Location Services → Safari.
guide.safariStep4: Refresh the page and press “Near me” again.

terms.title: TaskNow Terms of Use
terms.intro: Before using TaskNow, read what the platform does and does not take on. You need to accept them once.
terms.accept: I have read and accept the TaskNow terms. I understand that StaffNow is neither an employer nor a contracting party, holds no money, and that choosing a person is my own responsibility.
terms.acceptError: You need to accept the terms to continue.
terms.mockNote: acceptance stays only in this browser. In the real version it is stored on the account with date, IP address and terms version.
terms.s1b: TaskNow is a listing and communication service. It shows tasks posted by users and lets other users make an offer. StaffNow does not assign work, does not perform work, does not supervise and does not guarantee any outcome.
terms.s2t: 2. We are not a contracting party
terms.s2b: The agreement for each task is made exclusively between the person posting it and the person taking it on. Scope, price, timing, payment method and quality are agreed between them. No employment, mandate or agency relationship is created with StaffNow.
terms.s3b: StaffNow does not collect, hold or pay out fees for tasks. Payments are made directly between users. We do not mediate payment disputes and we do not issue refunds.
terms.s4b: Whoever takes on a task declares that they meet the legal requirements to provide the service, that they will issue the required invoice and that they are solely responsible for their tax and insurance obligations. This declaration is recorded before the first offer.
terms.s5b: Prohibited: illegal services; sexual or escort content; work requiring a professional licence that we do not verify (for example electrical, natural gas, medical, legal and financial services); work with obvious danger to people; and any attempt to bypass the platform in order to defraud another user.
terms.s6b: Anything the user uploads themselves — licences, certificates, qualifications — is shown as “declared” and has not been checked. Only what has been checked by a person gets a verification badge. No indicator is a guarantee of ability, quality or reliability.
terms.s7b: You choose the person who will take on the task, at your own responsibility, after considering rating, history, verifications and anything else you see fit. The same applies to the decision to take on a task.
terms.s8b: StaffNow is not liable for damage, injury, loss, delay, poor performance or non-payment arising from a task. To the extent permitted by law, our total liability is limited to any amounts you have paid us for the service in the last twelve months. The user must indemnify us against third-party claims caused by their own acts or omissions.
terms.s9b: We may remove a task or offer, restrict access or suspend an account, without prior notice, where the terms are breached, there is reasonable suspicion of fraud or there is a risk to users.
terms.s10b: We keep a history of tasks, offers, declarations and acceptance of terms — with date and IP address — to document transactions and comply with the law. Where required by digital platform legislation, tax details (e.g. tax ID) may be requested.
terms.s11b: The terms may change. For a material change, new acceptance will be requested before you continue using TaskNow.
terms.s12b: Greek law applies. The courts of Thessaloniki have jurisdiction.

openingSoon.text: We are preparing the part where you post a small job — dog walking, a move, cleaning, an errand, a repair — and receive offers with an amount. We start in Thessaloniki. You already have an account, so you will be among the first able to post and take on jobs.
openingSoon.note: We hide nothing from you: right now there is no open task, neither yours nor anyone else’s.

page.respTitle: What TaskNow does and does not do
page.r1: It puts you in touch and shows you what we know about each person: rating, level, completed jobs, what has been verified.
page.r2a: For jobs that need a licence (electrical, plumbing, natural gas, refrigeration)
page.r2strong: no offer can be made without uploading a licence
page.r2b: . The licence shows as “declared” until a person checks it.
page.r3: an employer; it does not assign work and does not guarantee its execution. The agreement is between the two of you.
page.r4: hold money. You pay each other — and each of you has your own tax obligations.
page.r5: Not to post, not to make an offer, not when the job is done. No commission, no subscription, no hidden fees.
page.respFooter: You choose the person, at your own responsibility.
page.prohibited: Illegal services and sexual or escort content are not allowed.
page.how1d: Title, area, when you want it and how much you pay. Two minutes.
page.how2d: Verified users propose an amount and write you a few words.
page.how3d: You see rating, level, completed jobs and verifications.
page.bothText: You do not have to choose whether you are “the one asking” or “the one doing”. You post a job when you need a hand and take on another when you need money. The same goes for businesses.
page.whenPostText: You receive offers with an amount and a few words, see rating, level and what has been verified, and you choose. You rate at the end.
page.whenTakeText: You see what is near you, propose your own amount and build a reputation with every job you complete. You get rated too.
page.repText: Every completed job and every rating counts. No level is given at random and none promises work.
page.heroTitle: Small jobs that need a hand
page.heroText: Someone to walk the dog, move a sofa, clean a home. You post what you need, receive offers, and choose who you trust.
